ORRERY

III · Chronicle

Afilmofwinters

Wheel sideways through the instrument’s biography. Years tick like a plate camera.

attention·residual·latent·prior·token·embedding·weight·gradient·hallucination·inference·context·temperature·epoch·loss·alignment·emergence·attention·residual·latent·prior·token·embedding·weight·gradient·hallucination·inference·context·temperature·epoch·loss·alignment·emergence·

195001/07

The question

A paper asks whether a machine can think, then politely replaces the question with a game. We have been playing it ever since.

The original question, ‘Can machines think?’ I believe to be too meaningless to deserve discussion.
Alan Turing · 1950

197402/07

Winter

Funding freezes. The brass tarnishes. Promises outrun the math, and the dome goes dark for a decade that teaches the field its manners.

The spirit is willing, but the hardware is weak.
A laboratory note, often repeated

1958–8603/07

The perceptron, twice

A single layer of weights learns to draw a line. Then many layers learn to fold the paper until the line becomes a landscape.

The perceptron may eventually be able to learn, make decisions, and translate languages.
Frank Rosenblatt · 1958

201204/07

The deep turn

A contest of photographs. A network with many hidden rooms wins by a margin that is not a margin. The winter is declared over in a single evening.

It is not the size of the step. It is that the ground moved.
Field note · ImageNet

201705/07

Attention is all

A paper with a boastful title introduces a ring that looks at every other ring at once. Sequence no longer has to walk. It can glance.

Attention Is All You Need.
Vaswani et al. · 2017

202206/07

The public mind

The instrument leaves the laboratory and sits on a million desks. People talk to it as if it were a person, a search engine, a ghost, a clerk. All of those are wrong, and useful.

We did not give the world a mind. We gave it a mirror that talks back.
Observatory ledger

203507/07

The unfinished instrument

A speculative plate. Empty sockets where memory might go, a gap where judgment was promised. The orrery is still a model of a sky we do not fully own.

Do not close the dome. The weather is not done.
A note left on the instrument
